# Agent context contract

Every source record includes ID, type, locator, revision/date, publisher/owner,
rights, sensitivity, retrieval method, hash when practical and claims used.

`AGENT_CONTEXT.md` separates verified facts, observed code/runtime behavior,
interpretations, contradictions, gaps and stale evidence. It maps relevant
canonical docs and existing agent/skill/tool boundaries without copying entire
corpora. Secrets, personal data without purpose, hidden reasoning and raw
production memory are excluded or sanitized.

Stop when the named architecture/evaluation decision has sufficient evidence,
the next cycle cannot change it, authority is missing, or risk exceeds scope.
